question: Which of the following units is used for measurement of concentration (of the amount of a substance)?
solution:
The correct answer is__**:Mole.**__ 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mole:**

 
 
• **The mole is the unit of measurement for the mass of substances in the International System of Units (SI).**
 
• 1 mole of 12 carbon atoms has 6.02214076*10²³ atoms and the mass is 12 grams. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Joule:**

 
 
• **​**Joule is a unit of energy derived from the International System of Units(SI).
 
• It is equal to the energy transferred to the object when a force of one Newton acts on the object for more than one meter in the direction of the force's movement.
 
 
 
• **Tesla:**
 
 
• **​**Tesla is a unit derived from the intensity of the magnetic field B in the International System of Units.
 
• One Tesla is equal to one Weber per square meter.
 
 
 
• **LUX:**
 
 
• It is the amount of illumination provided when a lumen is evenly distributed over a square meter area.
 
• This also equates to all the illumination that will exist on the surface within one meter of the point light source of an international candle.
